description: Flavour graph for The Crown. Called by script_venue_regular via the trigger's voice param.

f0.text: The halo dims a half-step as you pass under it, which is either scheduled or manners.

f1.text: Someone very expensive nods at you and then explains to their companion, at length, that they know you.

f2.text: A server does not ask. A server never asks any more.

r0.text: A server crosses the deck to you first, which up here is a public statement.

r1.text: Your name gets used out loud, correctly, in front of other people. That was the point of it.

r2.text: A table is found. It was always there. It is now yours.

s0.text: The staff arrange themselves so that you are always in someone's peripheral vision and never in anyone's way.

s1.text: A server asks if you are meeting somebody. The question is doing a great deal of work.

s2.text: Somebody prices your coat, finds the number, and stops thinking about you entirely.

name: Venue voice — The Crown
